params.name: apiKey
params.description: Your Sovrn Commerce API key. Found in the Sovrn Platform under Site Settings or via the Campaigns API.

params.name: market
params.description: Market in the format currency_language (e.g., usd_en). Inferred from IP if not provided.

params.name: cuid
params.description: Custom tracking ID for associating recommendations with a specific user, session, or page.

params.name: priceRange
params.description: Price filter using "min-max" format, e.g., "20-50" or "*-25".

params.name: includeMerchants
params.description: Comma separated list of merchant IDs to include. Only one of includeMerchants or excludeMerchants may be used.

params.name: excludeMerchants
params.description: Comma separated list of merchant IDs to exclude. Only one of includeMerchants or excludeMerchants may be used.

params.name: numProducts
params.description: Number of products to return. Default: 4, Max: 50.

params.name: pageUrl
params.description: The URL or key of the content you want recommendations for. See the 'Caching' section above for more information.
